confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Marrakech prices, brought forward to July 2026. No live listings, booking pages or price sources were inspected or cited. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel rates are least certain because summer demand and events swing them widely. Dirham-to-dollar rate assumed at about 9-10 per dollar. Draft beer is uncommon, so the beer anchor reflects a typical domestic serving in a licensed venue; cocktail (about 2x beer) and wine (about 1.4x beer) rely on that beer relationship. FX 0.6955 (2026-10-15) came from search-indexed RBA exchange-rate summaries with conflicting timestamps, not a direct read of the live table; the 14 October figure in those sources was 0.7002.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis only: general knowledge of Morocco's tourist-city price levels for medina and Gueliz restaurants, riads and hotels. No single comparable foreign city was used. Drink anchors are set relative to beer: cocktail about 2x beer and wine by the glass about 1.4x beer.
